entities.summary: The Bibliothèque Inguimbertine is a scholarly library located in Carpentras. It was established by Joseph-Dominique d'Inguimbert, the Bishop of Carpentras from 1735 to 1754. It has been called "the oldest of our municipal libraries" by chief librarian Jean-François Delmas. It currently contains about 220,000 books. Bibliothèque Inguimbertine is a museum in Europe, established in 1745. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
